citation_tracing.result: Fish-price baseline references led to the original GIZ women’s fisheries report, included as PU06.
Publisher links a March 2024 correction; identity verified, correction body unavailable. Do not infer its scope.
Muse (2025) final evaluation is a retrieval lead; publisher forward-citation list includes the 2026 aquaculture review. Neither was treated as independent confirmation of program effects.
Appendix 7 traces cost illustrations to UNICEF/World Bank solar-water references; these are not newly measured Somali pump prices.
Publisher reference list includes World Bank/FAO agriculture and AQUASTAT material; these are contextual leads, not proof of the modeled farm duty.

access_notes: Publisher-abstract-only items PU02 and PU03 retain that label; no paywall circumvention was used.

PU11 and PU17 publisher pages returned access errors; ResearchGate explicitly labeled the accessible article text as publisher full text provided by Taylor & Francis. Findings were checked in those original article sections, not ResearchGate summaries.
PU15 is the original report uploaded by its named author; a repository DOI does not establish journal peer review.
PU16 is explicitly a non-peer-reviewed preprint; posting year must not be substituted for undisclosed fieldwork dates.
Direct public PDFs were cached only for inspection. No PDFs, extracted text or copied abstracts are proposed for GitHub redistribution.
No claim is made that every publication has been audited for all subsequent corrections/retractions. The PU02 correction and PU12 version history were specifically checked.
